description: This Java class provides utility methods for converting various types of ThingEvent objects into Thing objects, and for merging Thing information with additional signal data. It includes mappings for different event types and handles merging logic based on presence of extra fields.

classes.name: ThingEventToThingConverter
classes.description: Utility class for converting ThingEvent instances to Thing objects and merging with signal data.

methods.name: thingEventToThing
methods.description: Creates a Thing object from a given ThingEvent, if possible.

methods.name: mergeThingWithExtraFields
methods.description: Merges Thing information from a signal event with additional fields, prioritizing signal's Thing data.

methods.name: createEventToThingMappers
methods.description: Initializes a map of event class types to functions that convert them into Thing objects.
